issues.issue: The departmental schedule's 'Supplies and Other' column totals 21,231,072, which is far more than the statement's 'Supplies and other' of 10,732,715 (p3). It also holds employee benefits, professional fees, utilities, repairs, rentals and insurance. Every 'Supplies and Other' line (detail[28]-detail[96] odd items) is categorized as supplies and materials, but only detail[28] carries a review note.

issues.on_page: Legal and accounting - Supplies and Other 113,726
issues.issue: Legal and accounting is professional/contract services, not supplies and materials.
A hospital's noncapital grants are often government (federal/state) grants. The category is defensible and already marked review, but federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid may fit better.
